content.title: Building Contractor License
content.summary: The City of Arvada requires all contractors involved in building construction, alteration, remodeling, repair, and equipping to obtain a contractor license. Homeowners working on their own occupied private residence are exempt, but those working on residences they own but do not occupy must be licensed or hire a licensed contractor. Licenses are valid for one year and must be renewed annually.
content.eligibility: Contractors involved in construction, alteration, remodeling, repairing, and equipping of buildings and structures in the City of Arvada. Homeowners working on their own occupied private residence are not required to be licensed. Homeowners working on residences they own but do not occupy must be licensed or hire a licensed contractor.

steps.title: Create an Account and Apply Online
steps.text: All new applications and renewals of existing applications are completed online at the Arvada Permits site.

steps.title: Application Review
steps.text: Applications will be reviewed within 5 business days from submission. Once the application is approved, you will receive an email notification for payment.

steps.title: Make Payment
steps.text: Payments can be completed online or checks are accepted via mail to 8101 Ralston Road, Arvada, CO 80002. Please include the AEC number or the name of the license on the check.

steps.title: Receive License
steps.text: Once all requested paperwork and qualifications are submitted and the application is approved, the license will be emailed to you.

faqs.q: Do homeowners need a contractor license to work on their own residence?
faqs.a: Homeowners doing work on their personal private residence that they own and occupy are not considered contractors and do not need a license. However, homeowners working on residences they own but do not occupy must be licensed or hire a licensed contractor.

faqs.q: How long is a contractor license valid?
faqs.a: Contractor licenses are valid for one year after issuance and must be renewed annually.

faqs.q: Where do I apply for a building contractor license?
faqs.a: All applications and renewals are completed online at the Arvada Permits site.

faqs.q: What qualifications are required for a Builder's Unlimited I-B license?
faqs.a: Passing the ICC F11 minimum test or being licensed in a Colorado jurisdiction where you have tested.
